name: cue-agent-eval
description: A/B test cue PROFILES with @vercel/agent-eval — same task, same model, the profile's CLAUDE.md is the only variable.

scripts.skill:dry: bun skill-ab/experiment.ts && cd skill-ab && agent-eval run-all --dry --force ponytail-before ponytail-after
scripts.skill:smoke: bun skill-ab/experiment.ts --require-key && cd skill-ab && agent-eval run-all --smoke --force ponytail-before ponytail-after
scripts.skill:eval: bun skill-ab/experiment.ts --require-key && cd skill-ab && agent-eval run-all --force ponytail-before ponytail-after
